title: HybridTrace Normalization Rule Classification (BisimExact vs. GuardedBisim vs. RefinesOnly)

rules.name: CopyProp_MoveCopyReg
rules.minissa_construct: copyReg dst src / direct SSA value substitution
rules.side_condition_phi: src is statically initialized along all reaching paths (guaranteed by mir_borrowck initialization analysis for non-moved locals)

rules.name: ConstProp_ScalarAndPair
rules.side_condition_phi: c has been resolved and validated at capture/RequiredConsts (no unevaluated CTFE panic/UB)

rules.name: SimplifyCfg_GotoChainCollapse
rules.minissa_construct: direct sequential composition in merged basic block

rules.name: Mem2Reg_NonEscapingSlot
rules.mir_construct: StorageLive(s); StoreField(s, i, v); LoadField(dst, s, i); StorageDead(s)
rules.minissa_construct: copyReg dst v / SSA phi node
rules.side_condition_phi: no address-of (&raw const/mut s or escaping &s) taken; every LoadField is dominated by a definite StoreField of the same type after StorageLive(s) and before StorageDead(s)

rules.name: SROA_ScalarizeAggregateCopy
rules.side_condition_phi: paddingValid: aggregate type has no unvalidated niche/discriminant violation and every scalarized field satisfies validValue(FieldTy) at the copy point

rules.name: ElideShortLivedReborrow_SliceSubslice
rules.mir_construct: StorageLive(s); s = &(*src)[offset..]; dst = move s; StorageDead(s)
rules.minissa_construct: sliceSubSsa dstPtr dstLen srcPtr srcLen offset
rules.side_condition_phi: noConflict: temporary borrow local s does not escape and no raw-pointer access to the same allocation occurs between StorageLive(s) and StorageDead(s) that would conflict with s's Tree Borrows retag

rules.name: InlineNonRecursiveCallee
rules.mir_construct: TerminatorKind::Call { func, args, destination, target: Some(bb_ret), unwind }
rules.minissa_construct: inlined callee MiniSSA blocks with parameter bindings and return jump
rules.side_condition_phi: callee is statically resolved, target_features(callee) ⊆ target_features(caller), and parameter ABI/validity attributes (noundef, align, Tree Borrows two-stage protector entry checks) are preserved as explicit entry guards if not statically discharged

rules.name: CheckDivRem_Preserved
rules.side_condition_phi: divisor zero check and signed INT_MIN / -1 overflow check are preserved identically

rules.name: DeadLoadElim_Guarded
rules.side_condition_phi: slotInitAndLive: place is proven live, aligned, dereferenceable, and initialized to a valid value of its type

rules.name: DeadLoadElim_Unguarded
rules.side_condition_phi: REJECTED by checkNormBisim: erasing an uninitialized or out-of-bounds dead load hides source MIR UB (refinesOnly_deadUninitLoad_unsound_for_vc_transport)

rules.name: DeadDivRemElim_Unguarded
rules.mir_construct: Assign(unused_tmp, BinOp::Div(num, denom)) without proving denom != 0
rules.side_condition_phi: REJECTED by checkNormBisim: erasing a dead division by zero hides source MIR UB/panic

rules.name: RemoveStorageMarkers_WithDanglingRawPtr
rules.mir_construct: StorageDead(s) while raw pointer p = &raw const s is later dereferenced
rules.minissa_construct: keep s live across entire function stack frame
rules.side_condition_phi: REJECTED by checkNormBisim unless address of s never escapes to a raw pointer dereferenced after StorageDead(s)
